title: Monitoring
description: Metric history with explicit units, sample times and missing-data gaps.
notes: History includes owner/server revision, units, interval/window and timezone. Numeric time series, not arbitrary raw output.
Missing data is a chart gap, not zero. Counter resets marked at source; stale/delayed samples retain actual observation time.
Range and sampling frequency are bounded; querying deleted/historical revisions labels their original identity. Table is chart alternative.

title: Collection schedules
description: Bounded read-only collection with explicitly delegated user authority.
notes: Grant expiry/revocation, ownership changes or deletion stops new collection. UI does not imply an unrestricted global service credential.
Production scheduler uses lease/deduplication and quotas; no catch-up storm or promise every missing sample can be recovered.
Configuration form must validate frequency/retention budgets and explicit target/revision; sample limits here are provisional.

title: Alert inbox
description: Owner-scoped alerts for sustained breaches, recovery and unavailable data.
notes: Rule form: owner target, metric/unit, comparison/threshold, window and in-dashboard delivery; validate missing-data handling separately.
Deduplicate sustained alerts; recovery is distinct from missing data and flapping. No external notification provider is required.
Empty inbox is not proof targets are healthy; collection/grant state remains visible.

title: Troubleshooting evidence
description: Read-only bounded investigation before any proposed change.
notes: Deterministic workflow works without AI/WebMCP. Remote logs remain untrusted data, never instructions.
Evidence records target/revision/collection time; missing/unsupported tool leaves a visible partial investigation.
Proposed mutations open independent resolved-step preflight; a workflow label is not approval.

title: Fleet comparison
description: Compare owned machines with bounded concurrency and honest partial results.
notes: 2 of 3 returned; partial results never imply full fleet success. Per-target times and errors remain visible.
Selection contains owned machines only. Bounded concurrency and owner quotas enforced by backend.
No bulk mutation implicit in compare; each resolved target/action needs applicable authorization and approval.

title: Maintenance workflow
description: Saved bounded steps with per-step approvals and resumable evidence.
notes: Workflow definition has explicit targets, parameters, privileges, checks and stop conditions. Review action button demonstrates step 2 only.
After restart, persisted unknown steps reconcile by inspection before continuation; never replay submitted mutations automatically.
Revocation or target revision change blocks subsequent steps. No generic rollback or remote-cancel guarantee.
Optional assistant/browser-agent slots may be added later; ordinary workflow is complete without provider credentials.
